create_session_manager: create a SessionManager with an inactivity limit and cleanup interval for managing ARESimulationGui sessions
add_are_simulation_instance: add a new ARESimulationGui instance to the SessionManager under a unique session ID
get_are_simulation_instance: retrieve an existing ARESimulationGui instance by session ID and update its last active timestamp
start_cleanup_timer: start the SessionManager background cleanup thread that periodically removes inactive sessions
stop_session_manager: stop the SessionManager and terminate all active ARESimulationGui instances and the cleanup thread
